traditional: the Moon conjunct Jupiter: the body, home, and daily needs fused with growth, fortune, and patronage. The two act as one and the combined significations are hard to separate.
modern: Feelings meet optimism and expansion. A resilient inner buoyancy that recovers no matter what, plus real generosity. Fused, these drives are difficult to separate and ask to be consciously integrated rather than acted out blindly.

cyclic.meaning: A new cycle of feeling and growth is sown: instinctive, full of potential, not yet conscious of itself.

business: Concentrated focus in this area. Warmth and generosity that draw people in; watch the tendency to overextend.
shadow: Moodiness and over-need fused with excess and overreach, with no distance to tell them apart.
arcApplying: The two fuse and intensify as they close in.
arcSeparating: The fused theme peaks and discharges.

readerCopy.body: When you are feeling a lot, more attention, advice, help, or generosity can become overwhelming surprisingly fast. When the Moon conjuncts Jupiter, emotions expand along with everyone’s desire to respond, which can turn one need into a flood of messages, visitors, opinions, spending, or promises. More support is not automatically better support. Decide what would actually make the situation easier before everyone else decides for you.
